segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: American teenagers may, for the first time in the nation's history, live shorter lives than their parents because of their unhealthy lifestyles. According to recent research:

segments.speaker: teen_a
segments.text: Ninety-six percent spend more than five hours looking at a screen every day.

segments.speaker: teen_b
segments.text: Eighty-six percent hardly ever eat fruit or green vegetables.

segments.speaker: teen_c
segments.text: Seventy-five percent don't usually sleep for eight hours a day – the average is seven hours.

segments.speaker: teen_a
segments.text: Thirty-four percent eat fast food at least once a day.

segments.speaker: teen_b
segments.text: Thirty-three percent drink more than four sugary drinks every day.

segments.speaker: teen_c
segments.text: Thirty-one percent are often very stressed.

segments.speaker: stats
segments.text: Twenty-five percent never play sports or exercise.
